checks.fact: Composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England.
Composite DTM spatial resolution is 1 metre.
Composite DTM uses Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Repeat-survey areas use the newest best-resolution data.
Resampled data uses bilinear interpolation before merging.
Location-specific survey lineage is available through metadata index catalogues.
LIDAR vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15 cm RMSE.
DTM is intended to model terrain surface after surface-object removal.
Surface-object removal uses algorithms and manual editing.
DSM and DTM must not be interchanged for parcel terrain measurement.
Composite vintage can differ by location.
A location-vintage check is required when terrain change could affect the parcel result.

promotion_rule: Exact revision 14 runtime output plus remote integrity readback is required before promoting any parcel height-difference value.
